title: Naturally Smoky Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: This smoky and adventurous Algerian dish features chicken cooked in a unique agave leaf vessel with chocolate chips and a blend of spices, making it a sugar free friendly option. The result is a crisp and flavorful meal with a rich history.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the agave leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, smoked paprika, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and sear the chicken until browned on all sides.
Wrap the agave leaves around the chicken to form a tight package, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the package in a large baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the package from the oven and sprinkle the dark chocolate chips on top.
Return the package to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is melted and the chicken is cooked through.
